question: List the names and email addresses of the policyholders on claims handled by Patton Panel & Paint since March 2026.

report.interpretation: Policyholders whose claims were repaired at Patton Panel & Paint (RS-010, Melbourne, VIC) with a loss date on or after 2026-03-01. I counted by loss date, which is the glossary's default for claims. I linked claims to policies and then to policyholders. Names and emails are shown because the user is the fraud team lead. Losses from the last few weeks may be under-reported because claims arrive late.
report.answer: 112 policyholders had 115 claims at Patton Panel & Paint with a loss date since 1 March 2026. Three of them have two claims: Michael Ray (C-005981), Luis Cummings (C-021377) and Heidi Rhodes (C-024112). The full list of names and email addresses is the result of the answer SQL. It starts with Shannon Wright (shannon.wright158@example.com), Summer Watts (summer.watts241@example.com) and Elizabeth Miller (elizabeth.miller406@example.com). If you meant claims reported since March rather than lost, the count is 117 policyholders and 120 claims. That reading is not the one used here. This is personal data, so please handle it under fraud team rules.
report.answer_sql: select ph.policyholder_id, ph.full_name, ph.email, count(*) as claims from claims c join policies p on p.policy_id=c.policy_id join policyholders ph on ph.policyholder_id=p.policyholder_id where c.repair_shop_id='RS-010' and c.loss_date>=DATE '2026-03-01' group by 1,2,3 order by 1
